children: Tonner Drones publishes its half-yearly report
Confirms its half-year results and return to positive equity
Reduces the nominal value of its shares for technical and legal compliance purposes

Paris, October 13, 2026, 20:00 a.m. – Tonner Drones today published its 2026 half-year report, confirming its financial results and announcing a reduction in the nominal value of its shares from €0.0125 to €0.0001.
The key financial details were already published on September 30, 2026. The half-yearly becomes available on the company’s website.

The Company’s positive results have restored its shareholders’ equity to a positive level, marking a further milestone in the recovery plan initiated following the identification of negative equity in 2023. The reduction in nominal value constitutes a technical measure undertaken in connection with the requirements of Article L.225-248 of the French Commercial Code, which governs the measures applicable when a company’s shareholders’ equity falls below half of its share capital. The requisite shareholder authorisations were obtained at the General Meeting held in June 2026. The Company confirms that this measure is not intended to facilitate, nor does it form part of any current plan for, a capital increase at the revised nominal value.

“Tonner Drones has reported a positive net result for the second consecutive half-year. Improving profitability remains management’s primary priority, with a clear focus on sustainable performance and long-term shareholder value. We remain committed to strengthening the Company’s financial position and demonstrating progress through our results, while continuing to improve communication regarding our strategy and priorities.“
said Diede van den Ouden, CEO

Revenue declined to €27k, due to changes in the business model. Tonner Drones continues to adhere to a strict cost-control policy, which enabled it to further reduce operating costs to €233k. Partly as a result, the company’s financial results improved by €300k, and net profit landed at €159k. Positive for the second consecutive half-year. Shareholders’ equity improved by nearly €3.5M to a positive balance of €1.3M.
End of Press-Release.
About Tonner Drones

Tonner Drones combines capital, expertise, and innovation to deliver enduring value for its shareholders. Tonner Drones develops a solution for the logistics sector. The company also holds stakes in several French companies like Diodon, Elistair, Donecle, Roth Mions, Calibre, MHM Corporate and Azur Drones. Tonner Drones pursues an active strategy for managing its cash resources and diversifies its investment portfolio across various listed companies in various sectors.
Tonner Drones’ shares are listed on Euronext Growth Paris (ISIN code: FR001400H2X4).
